Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Commercial team sits at the centre of Deliveroo’s marketplace—shaping how we serve restaurants, grocers, and new verticals worldwide. From negotiating key partnerships to unlocking new revenue streams and crafting data-led growth strategies, we take on big challenges that move the business forward. If you thrive in fast-paced, commercial environments and want to influence the future of a global brand—this is the team for you.
We’re looking for a Senior Rider Onboarding Associate to join our UKI team. This is a remote, field-based Fixed Term Contract (FTC) role with operational roots in Edinburgh, Manchester, Birmingham, Bristol, or London. In this role, you’ll help us build, scale, and optimise our physical onboarding ecosystem, directly securing the rider fleet capacity needed to power our three-sided marketplace.
Get to know our Commercial team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.
What You’ll Be Doing
You’ll be joining the Rider Enablement team. This sub-team acts as the operational foundation for rider supply across the United Kingdom and Ireland, managing logistical scaling challenges to ensure the fleet meets real-time marketplace demand.
Owing to the strategic scope of this seniority level, your responsibilities are split across two core operational pillars:
Strategy, Design & Scaling
Optimise hub performance:
Evolve the format and structural workflow of our physical Rider Onboarding Hubs to maximise operational efficiency before, during, and after daily sessions.
Scale the footprint:
Design, operationalise, and expand physical onboarding spaces across the UKI, implementing standardised systems to maintain high-quality service for all applicants.
Drive the strategic roadmap:
Architect and execute the 12-month delivery plan for in-person onboarding, balancing expansion with strict time and cost efficiencies.
Cross-functional problem solving:
Partner with Rider Support, Product, and broader Onboarding teams to troubleshoot live operational issues and funnel on-the-ground intelligence into long-term system enhancements.
Field Operations & Fleet Enablement
Deliver field onboarding:
Travel extensively across the UKI to lead face-to-face onboarding sessions and support localized operations within regional hubs.
Manage local supply constraints:
Target and eliminate rider deficits in hard-to-source zones, collaborating with the Supply team to build accurate demand forecasting models.
Execute seasonal campaigns:
Lead tactical supply planning and execution for peak trading seasons to stay ahead of consumer and partner growth.
What You’ll Need to Thrive
Essential
Sector experience:
Proven operational experience within technology, start-ups, food delivery logistics, or direct experience working as a Deliveroo Rider.
Autonomy and resilience:
A self-starter mindset with a demonstrated ability to work independently in the field, navigate changing operational priorities, and use your own initiative.
Stakeholder management:
Strong empathetic listening and communication skills, with the capability to influence internal product teams and manage candidate groups.
Mobility and licensing:
A valid UKI driving licence and access to your own vehicle for locations underserved by public transport, along with the flexibility to travel early and late.
Nice to Have
Technical tools:
Familiarity with G Suite, Slack, Looker, and Salesforce tooling.
Language skills:
Professional proficiency in Portuguese or Arabic.
Note: This is a 6-month Fixed Term Contract (FTC) with the possibility of extension. All field-based travel, accommodation, and personal vehicle mileage expenses will be fully covered by the company.

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

Build a career, not just a role

Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

postings.description:
Senior Product Manager, Core People Technology
Location:
London |
Work model:
Hybrid |
Reports to:
Senior Manager, People Product
About the team
People Technology builds and runs the systems behind every hire, transfer, leave, pay change and offboard for our workforce across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt. Our mission is to make the operational backbone of People Operations invisible when it works — reliable, compliant, and scalable across dozens of markets — so our people teams can focus on people, not process. This role sits on the People Product team, working alongside Business Systems Analysts, engineers and delivery leadership to bring product thinking to one of our highest-volume, highest-consequence surfaces.
About the role
Core is the Workday and HR platform surface that nearly every People Operations process runs through — pay, leave, employment status, right to work, and multi-country compliance for a global workforce. Demand structurally exceeds capacity, and requests arrive from every direction without a shared shape. You'll be the first dedicated product manager for this space, responsible for turning that inbound chaos into a defensible, well-communicated plan — and, over time, for building the intake, frameworks and partnerships that let the space run on systems rather than on you.
This is a hands-on individual contributor role: you'll be shaping tickets and sizing work alongside analysts and engineers, not managing from above.
What you'll be doing
Own the prioritised order of work for Core — building a clear, ranked plan, explaining the reasoning behind it, and being explicit about what's being deferred and why
Turn vague or incomplete partner requests into documented problems, mapped current-state processes, and testable outcomes
Partner directly and regularly with People Operations, Compliance, Payroll, Total Rewards and Business Systems Analysts, including holding "not now" conversations without damaging the relationship
Work hands-on with analysts and engineers to shape, size, and write tickets, keeping an accurate and current picture of committed, shipped, and carried-over work
Build and evolve the operating model across the analyst and engineering pod — the mechanisms, documentation and intake processes that let the space run with less coordination overhead
Use AI tools to accelerate translation of messy, multi-format, multi-language inbound requests into structured requirements and plans, while applying clear judgment about what should never be automated (anything touching pay, leave, employment status or right to work)
Escalate proactively on statutory or audit exposure, cross-space dependencies, and any trade-off that would move a compliance date
Report progress and delivery against plan to partners and leadership, including clear communication when outcomes fall short
Requirements
Experience owning a product or systems area end-to-end, with real decision rights over scope and sequencing — not co-ownership of a feature
Hands-on background with Workday or a comparable HRIS as a product manager or technical program manager, with genuine understanding of configuration, business processes, and integrations
Demonstrated ability to prioritise when demand structurally exceeds capacity, including a repeatable method (not just instinct) for deciding what to do and communicating what won't get done
Proven delivery in ambiguous, fast-moving environments, comfortable starting when requirements are incomplete or undocumented
Experience translating a partner's requested solution into a well-defined problem, current-state understanding, and testable outcome
Strong collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders, including compliance, payroll, or other regulated/audit-exposed functions
Practical fluency with AI tools for requirements drafting, documentation, and structuring unstructured information, paired with sound judgment about where not to apply them
Why Deliveroo
Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighborhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.
We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.
Workplace & Benefits
At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits in areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. Benefits are country-specific, please ask your recruiter for more information.
Diversity
At Deliveroo, we believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. That means we have no judgement when it comes to any one of the things that make you who you are - your gender, race, sexuality, religion or a secret aversion to coriander. All you need is a passion for (most) food and a desire to be part of one of the fastest-growing businesses in a rapidly growing industry.
We are committed to diversity, equity and inclusion in all aspects of our hiring process. We recognise that some candidates may require adjustments to apply for a position or fairly participate in the interview process. If you require any adjustments, please don't hesitate to let us know. We will make every effort to provide the necessary adjustments to ensure you have an equitable opportunity to succeed.

postings.title: Senior Social Media Manager - France
postings.description:
Why Deliveroo
Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.
We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, and looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.
Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Brand & Experience team builds the emotional connection between Deliveroo and our customers, riders, and partners. With a deep understanding of our audience and a passion for creativity, we bring our brand to life across every touchpoint. Whether it’s a push notification, social campaign, or packaging design, we craft compelling experiences that shape perceptions, spark engagement, and make Deliveroo a loved, global brand.
We’re looking for a
Senior Manager, Social Media - France
to lead the strategy, planning and delivery of Deliveroo’s French social presence. You’ll shape how Deliveroo shows up across social channels, ensuring our work is culturally relevant, platform-native, creatively ambitious and connected to our wider marketing and business strategy.
Sitting within our Global Brand Marketing function and reporting to the Director, Social, Cultural and Earned Media, you’ll work closely with our France Marketing team, agency partners and colleagues across Brand, Media, Integrated Marketing, Consumer Communications, Commercial, Grocery and Retail.
This role is open to applicants based in
France or England
and follows a hybrid working model, with three days a week in either our
Paris or London HQ
.
What You’ll Be Doing
You’ll be joining our Social, Culture and Earned Media team, connecting people with Deliveroo through the moments, partnerships and experiences that matter most. You’ll balance strategic ownership with hands-on leadership, setting the long-term direction for social in France while ensuring our day-to-day presence is timely, engaging and effective.
Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:
Set the direction for social in France
, leading our strategy and roadmap across always-on activity, brand campaigns, commercial priorities, cultural moments and reactive opportunities, with a focus on building brand equity, consideration and cultural relevance.
Turn global thinking into locally relevant work
, translating brand and campaign strategies into social-first ideas, formats and executions that resonate with French audiences and feel native to each platform.
Lead our French social presence
, overseeing channels including Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and YouTube, as well as the content calendar, tone of voice and community engagement approach.
Bring teams and partners together
, acting as the senior social lead for France and collaborating across local Marketing, Brand, Media, Commercial, PR, Global and European Social teams to embed social early in campaign planning and share learnings across markets.
Lead creative delivery and partnerships
, managing agency partners and influencer activity from briefing and production through approvals and launch, ensuring work meets the right creative, strategic and operational standards.
Keep Deliveroo connected to culture
, monitoring French culture, creators, communities, trends, platform behaviours and competitors to identify credible opportunities for Deliveroo to join or lead conversations.
Turn performance into progress
, establishing effective ways of working, reporting on social performance and community insights, and using those learnings to optimise content, campaigns and channel strategy. You’ll also coach junior team members and contribute to raising social standards across markets.
What You’ll Need to Thrive
Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:
Deep social and cultural expertise
, with strong knowledge of major platforms including Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and YouTube, alongside an excellent understanding of French culture, internet behaviour, creators, communities and trends.
Flawless written French and excellent English communication skills
, with the judgement to develop distinctive, accurate and culturally relevant brand communications.
Strong strategic and creative judgement
, with experience developing social strategies and campaigns that build brand visibility, engagement and cultural relevance, from initial strategy and briefing through execution, optimisation and reporting.
A data-informed approach
, with a strong understanding of social metrics and the ability to translate performance and community insights into clear recommendations that improve future work.
Strong leadership and collaboration skills
, with experience managing agency partners, creative development, stakeholders and competing priorities, alongside the ability to coach junior colleagues, influence effectively and operate autonomously in a fast-moving environment.
Why Join Us?
We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community organisers, proud parents, and more. All energised with an entrepreneurial, relentless spirit which helps us do big things as a team.
🔧
High autonomy
to build and deliver impactful work
🌱
Support to learn and grow
, from L&D programmes to mentoring
💚
Wellbeing matters
, with resources and benefits designed to support our people
🌍
A place to belong
, with a global workforce and active employee communities
Our benefits differ by country and include support across areas such as healthcare, wellbeing, parental leave, pensions and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. Your recruiter can tell you more about the benefits available in your location.
The Interview Process
We aim to create a fair process that gives you the opportunity to show us your experience, thinking and approach. The process will typically include conversations with our recruitment team and key stakeholders across Brand Marketing, giving you the chance to learn more about the role and team while we explore your social media expertise, strategic thinking, creative judgement, leadership and collaboration style.
Your recruiter will share the full interview process and what to expect at each stage.

We are building a new team that takes end-to-end ownership of AI initiatives – from strategy through to production. In many AI projects, there is a gap between the strategy and what ultimately makes it into production and creates real business value. That is exactly the gap we close.
Our work does not stop at the concept stage, nor does it begin with a finished specification. You own the architecture and technical delivery of the AI solution end to end – from strategy through to production.

You can hold your own at the executive level.

A proven track record of taking LLM-based systems into production – ideally in a

Description de l'emploi:
Vos missions
Réaliser les soins infirmiers et assurer le suivi des plans de soins.
Observer l'évolution de l'état physique et psychique des résidents.
Collaborer avec une équipe pluridisciplinaire.
Accompagner les résidents et leurs proches avec bienveillance.
Ce que nous offrons:
Chez Korian, nous veillons ensemble et avec notre cœur au bien-être et à la dignité de chacun. Notre philosophie Positive Care, axée sur la joie de vivre, l'hospitalité et l'attention sincère, est à la base de nos soins. Elle détermine la manière dont nous traitons nos résidents et dont nous collaborons entre nous. Guidés par cette philosophie, nous ne sommes pas un employeur ordinaire, mais une organisation où le travail d'équipe et la collaboration occupent une place centrale.
En outre, nous vous offrons:
un contrat à temps plein, à durée indéterminée
, en résidence neuropsychiatrique, avec un salaire conforme au marché selon les barèmes IFIC et la reprise de ton ancienneté ;
une participation à l'établissement de ton horaire, afin que tu puisses concilier parfaitement vie professionnelle et vie privée ;
de nombreux avantages supplémentaires, tels que des chèques-repas, le remboursement des frais de déplacement domicile-travail, le remboursement des vêtements de travail et des réductions pour le personnel ;
la possibilité de faire partie d'une communauté solidaire, avec de la place pour l'initiative personnelle et le développement professionnel via la Korian Academy ; un environnement de travail sûr et sain, axé sur le bien-être, la santé et la sécurité ;
un équilibre sain entre vie professionnelle et vie privée ;
une équipe motivée, toujours prête à s'entraider ;
une prime de recommandation pour chaque nouveau collègue recruté (1 500 € pour les infirmiers, 1 000 € pour les autres profils de soins).
À propos de l'entreprise:
Korian est l'un des principaux prestataires de soins en Belgique dans le domaine des soins résidentiels aux personnes âgées, avec près de 120 maisons de repos, résidences-services, centres de soins de jour, centres de convalescence et services de psychogériatrie. Nous proposons également des soins à domicile, des soins infirmiers à domicile et des services via des titres-services, afin de pouvoir prendre soin des personnes, jeunes et âgées, dans leur propre environnement, en toute sécurité.
Notre philosophie Positive Care est au cœur de nos maisons de repos. Nous croyons que chaque personne est unique et a droit à une attention sincère et à la joie de vivre. C'est pourquoi nous créons ensemble un environnement chaleureux, sûr et familial où les résidents se sentent vraiment chez eux. Vous travaillez au sein d'une équipe multidisciplinaire où la collaboration, le respect et l'engagement sont essentiels. Korian vous accorde sa confiance, vous confie des responsabilités et vous laisse toute liberté pour utiliser votre expertise, tout en vous offrant le soutien d'un groupe de soins solide.
Exigences:
Votre profil
Bachelier ou brevet en soins infirmiers avec visa valide.
Intérêt marqué pour la psychiatrie ou la santé mentale.
Esprit d'équipe, autonomie et bonnes qualités relationnelles.
Une expérience en psychiatrie est un atout, mais pas indispensable.

postings.title: Electromechanieker Beveren Vast contract
postings.description:
Electromechanieker Beveren

Werk jij graag met je handen, ben je technisch onderlegd en wil je een job waar je écht mee het verschil maakt? Dan is de functie van technieker bij CleanLease Lokeren iets voor jou. Jij zorgt ervoor dat onze machines blijven draaien en helpt mee nadenken over het verbeteren van de apparatuur. Daarnaast krijg je de kans om bij te leren op het vlak van elektrotechniek, mechanica, hydrauliek en pneumatiek.

Wat ga je doen als onderhoudstechnieker/ Storingstechnieker?

Je start energie- en nutsvoorzieningen op en controleert of alles goed werkt.

Je stelt installaties in, wijzigt parameters en werkt volgens de veiligheidsregels.

Je voert gepland onderhoud uit volgens onderhoudsschema’s en checklisten.

Je voert kleine aanpassingen uit en helpt bij het installeren van nieuwe machines of technieken.

Je spoort storingen op en voert zelf de nodige herstelwerkzaamheden uit.

Je sluit chemicaliën correct aan volgens de richtlijnen.

Je lost algemene technische problemen op, zoals sanitair, verlichting of verstoppingen.

Je houdt je werkzaamheden digitaal of op werkfiches bij.J

Je zorgt mee voor een veilige, propere en georganiseerde werkplek.

Je werkt met een hoogwerker als dat nodig is.

Voor deze vacature staan we open voor kwalitatieve voorstellingen van interimkantoren

Wat verwachten we van jou?

Je hebt een diploma TSO (zoals elektromechanica, elektriciteit of onderhoudstechnieken) of een technische bachelor.

Je hebt al ervaring als technieker

Je hebt kennis van elektriciteit, mechanica en/of pneumatiek. en dit in een productieomegeving

Je kan zowel zelfstandig als samen met collega’s werken.Je kan technische plannen lezen en begrijpen.

Je spreekt vlot Nederlands.

Je hebt een BA4/ BA5 of bereid dit te behalen

postings.title: Électromécanicien à Villers
postings.description:
En tant que spécialistes de l’entretien durable des textiles, nous souhaitons nous améliorer chaque jour davantage. Pour nos clients, nos collègues et pour l’environnement. Depuis plus de 100 ans, nous sommes spécialisés dans le nettoyage et la location de textiles de haute qualité. Nous fournissons nos services aux hôpitaux (cure), aux établissements de soins (care) et aux parcs de vacances (leisure), tant aux Pays-Bas qu’en Belgique.

En tant que partenaire fiable, nous accompagnons nos clients et leur proposons des solutions globales sur mesure. Nous visons une amélioration continue de la qualité, l’optimisation des coûts tout au long de la chaîne et la réduction de notre empreinte carbone. Nous travaillons d’arrache-pied pour satisfaire nos clients, mais nous prenons tout autant de plaisir à travailler ensemble. Ensemble, nous nous serrons les coudes et célébrons nos succès. Ensemble, nous formons un seul et même CleanLease. Serez-vous notre nouveau collègue ?

Le défi
Chez CleanLease, vous aurez l’occasion de vous développer dans les domaines de l’électrotechnique, de la mécanique, de la pneumatique et de l’hydraulique. Vous aurez également la possibilité de participer activement à la réflexion sur l’amélioration de nos machines.

Qu’allez-vous faire ?

• Démarrer les installations énergétiques et les services utilitaires et veiller à leur bon fonctionnement.

• Préparer les installations pour leur mise en service, configurer les programmes ou paramètres requis, conformément aux consignes de sécurité en vigueur.

• Assurer la maintenance préventive du parc de machines de production sur la base des schémas de maintenance ou des checklists indiqués, afin d’éviter l’usure, les pannes ou les ruptures.

• Effectuer des travaux d’adaptation et assister lors de l’installation de nouvelles machines ou équipements techniques.

• Intervenir en cas de panne ou de défaut technique : établir un premier diagnostic et réaliser les réparations nécessaires.

• Assurer le raccordement des produits chimiques. • Effectuer des réparations générales (sanitaire, éclairage, débouchage de conduites, …).

• Enregistrer les travaux effectués sur une fiche de travail ou dans l’ordinateur. • Réaliser les travaux de maintenance en respectant les consignes de sécurité liées aux risques physiques personnels et envers les tiers.

• Utiliser une nacelle élévatrice pour certaines interventions. • Veiller à l’ordre et à la propreté dans l’atelier et lors des interventions sur les postes de travail.

Qui êtes-vous ?
Avez-vous de l’expérience en tant que technicien de maintenance dans un environnement de production ? Ou êtes-vous bientôt diplômé ? Cherchez-vous un emploi avec beaucoup d’autonomie et de liberté ? Alors vous êtes la personne que nous recherchons

postings.description:
WIE ZIJN WIJ?

Hoorcentrum Aerts bv groeide op 23 jaar tijd uit tot één van de meest gespecialiseerde aanbieders van hooroplossingen. Door de laatste technologische ontwikkelingen op de voet te volgen, zijn onze aangeboden hoorapparaten, oordoppen en gehoorhulpmiddelen evenals de meet-en analysetoestellen state of the art.

De kwaliteit van onze producten evenals de kwaliteit van de zorg en service voor onze klanten staan centraal. Om iedere klant de meest aangepaste en optimale oplossing te adviseren, staan gediplomeerde en professionele medewerkers paraat.

Momenteel hebben we een netwerk van meer dan 80 winkels opgebouwd en zijn we nog sterk aan het uitbreiden. Hier werken dagelijks een 150-tal medewerkers met hart en ziel aan mee.

Wil je, net als ons, mensen blijven verbinden en meewerken aan de groei van onze organisatie? Spits dan de oren, want wij zijn op zoek naar jou!

Voor een flexibele inzetting in ons hoorcentra
te
Brussel, Sint-Pieters-Leeuw, Liedekerke, Alsemberg, Merchtem & Grimbergen
zijn wij voor een voltijdse tewerkstelling op zoek naar een:

onthaal & administratief medewerker

(op dinsdag werken wij met een avondopening; hiervoor krijg je elke dinsdag in de voormiddag vrij!)

Als onthaal- en administratief medewerker sta je enerzijds in voor een professionele en gastvrije ontvangst van onze klanten zowel fysiek, telefonisch als digitaal. Anderzijds bied je administratieve en logistieke ondersteuning naar klanten en collega’s toe.

jouw takenpakket

• je staat in voor het klantenonthaal

• je verstrekt algemene informatie over hoorapparaten, hulpmiddelen en terugbetalingsbeleid aan de klant, volgt op en verwijst indien nodig door naar de audioloog

• je beheert informatie / documentatie en houdt deze up to date vb. klantendossiers

• je beheert de agenda van de audiologen

• je doet het voorraadbeheer en plaatst bestellingen

• je staat in voor de kassa administratie

• je reinigt hoorapparaten

• je neemt documenten / pakketten aan

• je zorgt voor orde en netheid in het filiaal

jouw profiel

• je bent allround: ondernemend, oplossingsgericht, commercieel en professioneel

• je werkt correct en nauwkeurig

• je bent stressbestendig

• je kan prioriteiten stellen (telefoon, mail, afspraken, …)

• je stelt je flexibel op

• je bent vlot communicatief, zowel mondeling als telefonisch, contactvaardig, en diplomatisch

• je spreekt duidelijk en verzorgd Nederlands: wij werken immers met slechthorende klanten

• je valt op door je klantgerichtheid

• je handelt volgens de opgestelde procedures en ziet verbeteringsmogelijkheden

• je hebt een opgewekte en enthousiaste persoonlijkheid

postings.title: DevOps Engineer
postings.description:
Als CI/CD DevOps Engineer sta je in voor het operationeel beheer van het CI/CD-ecosysteem en zorg je voor een stabiele, performante en toekomstgerichte dienstverlening. Je volgt build- en releaseprocessen nauwgezet op, detecteert verbeterkansen en biedt klanten via monitoring, rapportering, metrieken en gerichte feedback inzicht in de kwaliteit en efficiëntie van de dienstverlening.

Je ondersteunt development teams bij uitdagingen rond software delivery en automatisering. Je analyseert behoeften, stelt passende oplossingen voor, begeleidt klanten in het gebruik van de dienstverlening en werkt procedures en best practices uit.

Je ontwerpt, onderhoudt en optimaliseert build-, release- en deploymentprocessen. Daarbij analyseer je technische problemen en zet je in op automatisering om de efficiëntie te verhogen en operationele risico's te beperken.

Je werkt mee aan de modernisering en standaardisering van software delivery-processen en bouwt mee aan een schaalbare, veilige en toekomstgerichte omgeving.

Daarnaast beheer je softwareartefacten en repositories met aandacht voor governance, kwaliteit en security.
Tot slot integreer je DevSecOps-, kwaliteits- en securityprincipes in het software delivery proces. Zo draag je bij aan een efficiënte, veilige en betrouwbare uitrol van de software.
Je behaalde een master- of bachelordiploma in de informatica of je kan een gelijkwaardig niveau aantonen door relevante ervaring.

Je beschikt over een goede kennis van software delivery en DevOps-principes, inclusief source code management, CI/CD, buildautomatisering, scripting, Linux, configuration management, REST API's en Java-gebaseerde ontwikkelomgevingen. Kennis van DevSecOps, security en continuous improvement vormt hierbij een meerwaarde.

Daarnaast is ervaring met CI/CD-platformen, repository- en artefactbeheer, monitoring en rapportering, evenals met het opzetten en optimaliseren van geautomatiseerde software delivery-processen een pluspunt.

Je beschikt over een sterk analytisch vermogen en een gestructureerde, resultaatgerichte aanpak. Je combineert zelfstandigheid met een sterke teamgeest en weet collega's te ondersteunen, te coachen en kennis te delen.

Dankzij je communicatieve vaardigheden stem je je boodschap af op verschillende stakeholders en werk je klantgericht.

Daarnaast ben je georganiseerd, proactief en gedreven om continu verbeteringen te realiseren en projecten succesvol op te leveren binnen de afgesproken timing en beschikbare middelen.

Je communiceert vlot in het Nederlands en Frans en begrijpt het Engels.

postings.title: IT Infrastructure Coordinator
postings.description:
Als IT Infrastructure Coordinator ben je verantwoordelijk voor de stabiliteit, veiligheid en evolutie van de IT-infrastructuur.

Je stuurt het Infra-team aan en je bepaalt en evalueert de doelstellingen van een team van ongeveer zeven medewerkers, bestaande uit Support- en System Engineers/Administrators. In deze rol neem je een constructieve plaats in binnen het management van de ICT-afdeling en ben je verantwoordelijk voor het beheer van de volledige IT-infrastructuur, waaronder netwerken, servers, storage, cloudoplossingen, datacenters en beveiligingssystemen (o.a. Cisco, NetApp, Veeam en Trend Micro).

Samen met de ICT-directeur ontwikkel en implementeer je de infrastructuurstrategieën die aansluiten bij de algemene bedrijfsdoelstellingen. Je speelt een belangrijke rol in de verdere evolutie naar een infrastructuurmodel dat in toenemende mate steunt op de G-Cloud omgeving. In dat kader draagt de functie actief bij aan de transitie naar cloudgebaseerde diensten en aan het optimaal benutten van deze federale infrastructuur binnen de strategie van de instelling.

Daarnaast coördineer je diverse projecten, zoals G-Cloud initiatieven (IaaS en PaaS), NIS2 compliance, security initiatieven zoals phishingcampagnes en disaster recovery. Je stelt een IT-roadmap op voor de volledige infrastructuur en vertaalt businessbehoeften naar concrete technische oplossingen, bijvoorbeeld op het vlak van Microsoft Copilot/AI, SharePoint en cloudmigraties.

De functie omvat ook het onderhouden van relaties met externe partners en leveranciers, evenals actieve deelname aan Service Level Meetings, de opvolging van KPI’s en het beheer van certificaten. Daarnaast ben je verantwoordelijk voor het opstellen, opvolgen en bewaken van het INFRA IT-budget, met bijzondere aandacht voor kostenbeheersing.

Tot slot wordt de performantie en betrouwbaarheid van systemen en netwerken continu opgevolgd via automatisatie en ...
Je beschikt over een bachelor- of masterdiploma in Informatica en je hebt minimaal vijf jaar ervaring in infrastructuurbeheer of infrastructuurarchitectuur waarvan minstens drie jaar ervaring in een leidinggevende rol binnen IT.

Je beschikt over een brede technische kennis van netwerken, servers, operating systems (Linux en Windows), virtualisatie, storage, back-up, security, firewalling en monitoring.

Kennis van de Atlassian-stack, met name Jira en Confluence, vormt een troef. Ook ervaring met infrastructuurarchitectuur of solution design is een pluspunt.

Je bent hands-on, oplossingsgericht en neemt verantwoordelijkheid binnen jouw domein. Sterke analytische vaardigheden en interesse in strategische IT-initiatieven zijn daarbij essentieel.

Je bent een motiverende peoplemanager die helder kan communiceren met zowel technische als niet-technische stakeholders. Je werkt graag samen in teamverband en je hebt een positieve, klantgerichte ingesteldheid.

Een goede kennis van het Frans is een meerwaarde.

Tot slot vormt kennis van overheidsopdrachten, zoals raamcontracten en aankoopcentrales, evenals ervaring met het e-Procurementplatform, een bijkomend pluspunt.

postings.title: IT Domain Team Lead
postings.description:
Je maakt deel uit van een multidisciplinair team waarin verschillende expertises samenkomen om een optimaal beheer van het IT-domein te verzekeren. Als IT Domain Team Lead ben je verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkelingsteams binnen jouw domein (4 ontwikkelingsteams - totaal 25 personen). Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de IT-directeur van het ontwikkelingsdepartement.

Als tactisch organisator vertaal je de strategische doelstellingen van het departement naar een duidelijk en werkbaar kader voor je teams. Je zorgt ervoor dat deze visie wordt gedragen en omgezet in concrete acties en resultaten.

Je coördineert de werking en projecten van je teams en bewaakt kwaliteit, voortgang en prioriteiten. Met een helikopterview stem je af met stakeholders en stuur je tijdig bij voor een efficiënte en betrouwbare uitvoering.

In je rol als manager en coach ondersteun je je medewerkers in hun dagelijkse werking en ontwikkeling. Je zorgt voor een stimulerende werkomgeving waarin autonomie, samenwerking, feedback en talentontwikkeling centraal staan zodat teams optimaal kunnen presteren.

Als coach ondersteun je medewerkers in hun ontwikkeling en creëer je een veilige, inclusieve werkomgeving met ruimte voor feedback, autonomie en groei. Je stimuleert talentontwikkeling, een sterke teamdynamiek en gaat proactief om met spanningen.

Daarnaast treed je op als kennismanager met inzicht in de functionele, architecturale en technologische context van het ICT-domein. Je volgt evoluties op, bevordert kennisdeling en maakt expertise breed toegankelijk.

Tot slot bouw en onderhoud je sterke relaties met interne en externe stakeholders en sla je bruggen tussen ICT, business, teams en partners om maximale businesswaarde te realiseren.

- Je hebt een masterdiploma behaald, bij voorkeur in IT, of je kan een equivalente ervaring aantonen door relevante ervaringen in het beheer en de opvolging van één of meerdere ontwikkelingsteams.
- Je hebt ervaring in het organisatorisch aansturen van technische teams en toont leiderschap. Ook heb je ervaring in projectbeheer.
- Je hebt minstens 5 jaar ervaring in projectmanagement.
- Je bent analytisch en innovatief, trekt verbanden tussen gegevens en werkt creatieve, onderbouwde oplossingen uit. Je begeleidt en motiveert medewerkers, bevordert teamspirit en onderhoudt constructieve relaties met klanten en stakeholders. Je handelt integer, neemt verantwoordelijkheid, plant je eigen ontwikkeling en zet daadkrachtig resultaten om in actie.
- Je hebt kennis van Agile, Scrum en Prince2.
- Een pluspunt is je technische background in Java, JEE, OpenShift, SOA-webservices.
- Je drukt je vlot uit in het Frans en Engels.

postings.title: Functional Analyst
postings.description:
Als Functional Analyst vorm je de brug tussen business en functionele behoeften van de business en de technische realisatie door de ontwikkelteams. Je combineert inzicht in processen, analysevaardigheden en technische expertise om kwalitatieve oplossingen te ontwerpen. Je werkt nauw samen met business stakeholders, ontwikkelaars, testers en de Product Owner.

Je bepaalt mee de scope van middelgrote tot complexe development-projecten en je bewaakt de functionele samenhang van de oplossing.

Je fungeert als aanspreekpunt voor functionele verduidelijkingen gedurende het volledige traject, van analyse en ontwerp tot en met ontwikkeling, validatie en productie-name.

De toepassingen worden ontwikkeld in .NET & Azure Cloud aan de hand van Scrum-methodologie.
Je beschikt over een masterdiploma of een gelijkwaardige expertise. Je weet minstens 3 jaar ervaring in een gelijkaardige functie aan te tonen.

Je hebt ervaring in Agile/Scrum en een goede kennis van Agile-methodologieën.

Je hebt een diepgaande kennis van analysemethoden en modelleertechnieken (UML, BPMN, XML en webservices). Je hebt ervaring in het bieden van ondersteuning bij E2Etesting.

Kennis van API-analyse (REST/SOAP), databankmodellering (relationeel & logisch), SQL-queries en Sparx Enterprise Architect vormt een meerwaarde. Ook ervaring met het analyseren en reviewen van technische specificaties, kennis van Microsoft Azure DevOps en ervaring met TDD en BDD zijn troeven.

postings.title: Relations Partner Detachment
postings.description:
Als Relations Partner Detachment neem je een sleutelrol op binnen onze HR-afdeling en fungeer je als het centrale aanspreekpunt voor onze klanten voor alle aspecten van het detacheringsbeleid. Je bouwt duurzame relaties op met directies en ICT-verantwoordelijken en waakt over de correcte toepassing, kwaliteit en continuïteit van de volledige detacheringswerking.

Je dagelijkse takenpakket is heel gevarieerd:

- Noden, inzichten en best practices delen en bijdragen aan een optimale dienstverlening.

Daarnaast ondersteun je klanten bij het financiële beheer van hun gedetacheerde medewerkers, adviseert hen over de impact van beslissingen en licht facturatieprocessen toe.

Op HR-vlak ben je een belangrijke sparringpartner met helikopterzicht. Je creëert alignment tussen detachering, HR en operationele teams.

In samenwerking met HR Expert Centers stel je nota’s en documentatie op omtrent nieuwe of gewijzigde HR-processen en je begeleidt de klanten bij de correcte toepassing ervan.

Tot slot coördineer je overlegstructuren, maak je presentaties voor vergaderingen en volg je actiepunten nauwgezet op.
Als ervaren professional met een stevige achtergrond in een beleids-, management- of HR-rol ben je gewend om te werken met stakeholders op directieniveau. Je draagt een doordachte visie uit en weet te overtuigen met heldere argumenten.

In een complexe omgeving voel je je comfortabel en je schakelt vlot tussen analytisch denken en operationele opvolging (hands-on mentaliteit).

Je beschikt over sterke organisatorische en administratieve vaardigheden die je toepast om processen toe te lichten, te coördineren en bij te sturen waar nodig.

Een brede kennis van sociale wetgeving, arbeidsreglementering en budgettering is een belangrijke troef. Ervaring met analytics vormt een meerwaarde.

Je behoudt overzicht, weet prioriteiten te stellen en doordachte en gerichte acties te nemen in afstemming met HR-teams.

Je bent een natuurlijke netwerker, je bouwt vertrouwen op en weet duurzame samenwerkingen uit te bouwen. Je hebt oog voor kwaliteit en servicegerichtheid.

Daarnaast communiceer je vlot in het Nederlands en het Frans. Je bent overtuigend en diplomatisch en kan je informatie zowel schriftelijk als mondeling helder vertalen voor verschillende doelgroepen.

l bestaat uit ongeveer 90 (onderwijs)instellingen. Je krijgt een gevarieerde functie, werkt samen met betrokken collega’s en groeit stap voor stap in boekhouding en financiële administratie.

Wat ga je doen?

· Je verwerkt inkomende en uitgaande correspondentie, facturen en andere financiële documenten.

· Je controleert bestelbonnen en stemt facturen af met bestelbonnen en leveringsnota’s.

· Je bouwt expertise op in twee specifieke financiële domeinen, zoals verzekeringen, bankzaken, fiscaliteit, btw, verhuringen of groepsfacturatie.

Ervaring is mooi meegenomen, maar jouw motivatie om te leren vinden we minstens even belangrijk. Je herkent jezelf in het volgende profiel:

· Je hebt een basisinzicht in financiën en bent sterk gemotiveerd om boekhoudkundige processen, regelgeving en software aan te leren.

· Je bent digitaal vaardig en maakt nieuwe toepassingen, zoals boekhoudsoftware en Informat, snel eigen.

· Je gaat integer en vertrouwelijk om met financiële en gevoelige informatie.

· Je werkt graag samen, maar neemt ook zelfstandig verantwoordelijkheid op.

· Je staat open voor feedback en bekijkt je eigen functioneren kritisch.

postings.description:
KMO actief in bouw & waterbouw, kraanverhuur en zandhandel

Ben jij een nauwkeurige boekhouder met een hands-on mentaliteit? Werk je graag in een familiale KMO-omgeving waar samenwerking centraal staat? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou.

Voor onze groeiende onderneming, actief in de bouw- en waterbouwsector, zoeken wij een interne boekhouder die samen met twee ervaren collega’s de financiële administratie van onze projecten en activiteiten mee opvolgt.

Wij zijn een ISO 9001-, ISO 14001- en VCA-gecertificeerd bedrijf. Kwaliteit, milieu en veiligheid vormen dan ook een essentieel onderdeel van onze dagelijkse werking. We hechten veel belang aan medewerkers die deze professionele attitude mee uitdragen, zowel intern als naar klanten, leveranciers en partners toe.

Jouw functie

Als interne boekhouder maak je deel uit van een ervaren boekhoudteam. Samen zorgen jullie voor een correcte en efficiënte opvolging van de boekhouding en administratie van onze projecten en activiteiten.

Takenpakket

Inboeken van aankoop-, verkoop- en financiële documenten.

Opvolging van betalingen en leveranciers.

Voorbereiden van btw-aangiftes.

Debiteuren- en crediteurenbeheer.

Opmaak van maandelijkse rapporteringen.

Ondersteuning bij jaarafsluiting en audit.

Contact met accountant en externe partners.

Opvolging van projectadministratie binnen bouw- en waterbouwprojecten.

Meedenken over optimalisatie van administratieve processen.

Maandelijkse voorbereiding loonadministratie + payroll.

Bachelor bedrijfsmanagement - accountancy-fiscaliteit of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.

Affiniteit met de bouwsector is een pluspunt.

Goede kennis van boekhoudsoftware en MS Office.

Zelfstandig, discreet en gestructureerd.

Praktische ingesteldheid en verantwoordelijkheidszin.

Je stuurt het projectteam aan, bewaakt de voortgang, budgetten en kwaliteit, en zorgt voor een optimale samenwerking met alle betrokken partijen.

postings.title: Senior Revenue Ops
postings.description:
Health can’t wait
.
Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.
Alan exists to end the wait.
Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.
So we are building the
new standard in prevention insurance.
Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.
We are on an incredible journey to build a
global leading company, with a
unique culture
. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.
Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.
⭐️ The Senior Revenue Operations job
Our Business Strategy & Operations team runs the most critical, strategic, and data-driven projects at Alan. It sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Finance, and covers four core areas: sales strategy and planning, sales effectiveness, sales enablement, and business segment leadership.
You'll be joining the
Sales Effectiveness team
, whose mission is to make our sales organization run at its best across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. This team is a key lever on one of the company's most watched metrics: our customer acquisition cost.
Why is this role interesting?
High-impact scope
: You'll work across the full sales organization, from Account Executives to BDRs, Account Management, and Customer Success Managers.
Real ownership
: You'll own initiatives end to end, from strategy and design to execution and adoption, not just delivery.
Builder's playground
: You'll have access to a modern stack, combining low-code tools, AI (Dust, Claude), Salesforce, and SQL, to ship things fast and at scale.
Tangible results
: Recent examples from our roadmap include fully automating slide deck generation for Sales (saving 1,000+ hours per year) and building an AI-powered outbound machine reaching a 15% discovery rate.
What will you do with us?
You'll own effectiveness initiatives end to end, setting the roadmap, designing the solution, building it, driving execution, and managing change across the organization. You'll spend meaningful time in the field to spot gaps in our sales process, then design smarter workflows by eliminating steps and increasing automation. You'll evaluate new tools and technologies, run tests, and roll out what works.
You'll mostly work with low-code tools (like Zapier or n8n), AI, Salesforce, SQL via Metabase, and whatever else the job calls for. Enablement is a key part of the role: you'll shadow, train, measure adoption, and iterate until change sticks.

⭐ Is it you we're looking for?
You'll be a great fit for the Revenue Operations team at Alan if you:
Have
at least 5 years of experience
in a similar role (RevOps, Sales Ops, or Sales Effectiveness);
Demonstrate
strong ownership and project management
skills, and are comfortable running initiatives without hand-holding;
Have a
builder mindset
and love being hands-on;
Are confident with
change management
, including shadowing, training, measuring adoption, and iterating;
Have
at least intermediate SQL queries reading skills
. Being able to write and own queries autonomously is a nice to have.
Have proven experience with
low-code tools and integrations
(e.g. Clay, Make, Zapier, or equivalent) to build scalable workflows
Have direct hands-on experience in
Salesforce and/or Outreach
(not just awareness or admin-level use)
Are able to build and maintain pipelines that produce
actionable insights, with clear business impact
Have excellent verbal and written communication skills;
Have full working proficiency in
French
and at least an advanced level in
English
.
Are based in (or willing to relocate to)
Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes, Biarritz, Madrid or Barcelona.
For this role we are looking to hire within the
D-E level range
.
Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.
🙌
Perks & Benefits
At Alan, we believe that
being in good health is a basic need
, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are
happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time
with co-workers.
Therefore, we offer:
Fair rewards
. Generous equity packages complement your base salary,

⭐️ The mission of the Union Relations Lead
Unions and social partners play a central and legitimate role in how social protection is designed, negotiated and implemented in France. We're looking for a Union Relations Lead to build and animate Alan's relationships with unions, their federations, and the broader paritariste ecosystem, making Alan a trusted, substantive and well-known interlocutor of French social partners, and supporting our Enterprise & Public Sector teams across large private employers and public institutions.
⭐
What makes this role genuinely unique
You'll shape how one of Europe's fastest-growing health tech companies builds its relationships with the French social partner ecosystem (from confederations to sector federations to paritariste institutions).
You'll operate at the highest levels of the paritariste ecosystem: CFDT and FO confederal leadership, sector federations, IP boards, organisations patronales.
You'll shape the strategy, not just execute it. Alan is at an early stage of building this capability (the playbook is yours to define)
You'll work directly with Founders, Public Affair as well as Public Sector and Enterprise leadership.
Real ownership from day one, in one of the fastest-growing tech unicorns in Europe.

Relationships & Presence
Build and maintain trusted, long-term relationships
with the organizations that represent employees and members across the sectors that matter to Alan (unions, federations, and the structures that convene them).
Map the ecosystem, prioritize interlocutors

Represent Alan in federations, working groups, congrès and paritariste institutions
where our sector’s future is discussed.

Be a partner to our teams
serving large private employers and public sector clients, briefing them on the social partners context and how Alan’s offer speaks to their priorities
Introduce the right contacts
at the right moment in the commercial cycle, turning Alan’s ecosystem relationships into concrete commercial leverage.
Share Alan’s content
with social partners to help them assess Alan on its merits and form their own view.

Follow the dialogue
at branch level and across the paritariste ecosystem and turn that understanding into internal clarity.
Represent Alan in the federations and working groups
where our sector's future is discussed, contributing a constructive and recognizable voice.
Be a sharp, early internal voice on where social dialogue is heading
and on the implications for Alan's strategy.

: Build and maintain a knowledge library on social partner positions, branch agreements, and paritariste institutions shared with Enterprise and Public Sector deal teams to increase win rates.
Framework & tools
: Implement processes and AI tools to improve the quality and efficiency of our social partner engagement and documentation.

Market intelligence

Have at least 8 years of total experience in social partner relations

ability to engage federation leadership as a peer, built through a personal representative past or years of substantive engagement at federation level on employer side.

from the employer/state side

for social partner audiences

on an organization’s commercial and strategic outcomes

you accelerate others, you don't seek the spotlight.

Paris.

Legal background in droit social and comfort reading accords collectifs quickly.

postings.title: Partnership Manager - Accountant Sector
postings.description:
Health can’t wait
.
Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.
Alan exists to end the wait.
Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.
So we are building the
new standard in prevention insurance.
Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.
We are on an incredible journey to build a
global leading company, with a
unique culture
. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.
Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.
We are looking for an experienced Partnership Manager
to join our Accountant Partnerships team in France, specifically focused on building and developing relationships with accounting firms and accountant networks.
The core purpose of this role is to turn accounting firms into long-term Alan partners and advocates. You will help them recommend Alan to their clients, improve their day-to-day experience with health insurance and payroll administration, and generate qualified business opportunities for Alan’s Sales teams.
The accountant ecosystem represents a significant growth opportunity for Alan. France has approximately 22,000 accounting firms supporting around 3.5 million companies, and Alan’s existing Accountant Partnership channel has already generated significant ARR through a relatively small number of partners.
The team is now entering a new phase of development. We are hiring new Partnership Manager to help build a scalable, high-performing partner network and contribute to Alan’s ambition to make Accountant Partnerships a strategic growth channel.
Here is how your key outcomes will look like:
Build and grow a strong partner network:
Identify, prioritise and develop relationships with high-potential accounting firms and networks.
Drive partnerships from discussion to activation:
Lead partnership discussions, onboarding and launch, ensuring that Alan creates value for both accountants and their clients.
Activate partners and generate business opportunities:
Build engagement plans, support partner enablement and work closely with Sales to turn recommendations into qualified opportunities.
Help scale the Accountant Partnerships model:
Manage partner performance, share insights with internal teams and contribute to the development of scalable playbooks, tools and processes.
⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?
We’re looking for someone who combines strong partnership and commercial skills with the ability to build trusted relationships in a complex and evolving B2B ecosystem.
The ideal candidate will be comfortable managing partnerships from initial contact to activation and long-term development. They should enjoy working autonomously in an environment where there is still a lot to build.
You may be a great fit at Alan if you have/are:
5+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, account management or customer success in a B2B environment
Experience managing partnerships throughout the full lifecycle, from prospecting and closing to activation and ongoing relationship management
Experience managing a portfolio of partners, ideally in a fast-growing company
Strong negotiation, communication, presentation and relationship-building skills
A data-oriented mindset, with the ability to track performance and prioritise opportunities
The ability to collaborate effectively with Sales, Marketing, Product, Data and Operations teams
An entrepreneurial mindset, strong ownership and the ability to work autonomously
Full professional fluency in French and professional fluency in English
Experience working directly with accounting firms, payroll providers, HR software or insurance companies would be a strong plus.
We are particularly interested in candidates who have experience with B2B distribution partnerships, where a third party recommends or distributes a solution to its own customers. Experience limited to technology integrations, co-marketing or visibility partnerships would be less relevant for this role.
For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the
C0-D level
.
Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.
🙌
Perks & Benefits
At Alan, we believe that
being in good health is a basic need,
and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are
happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time
with co-workers.
Therefore, we offer:
Fair rewards
. Generous equity packages complement your base salary,
for permanent contracts only.
Flexible office with hybrid setup
. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.
All the tools you need
. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.
Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours
. Organize your time as you wish.
Delightful healthcare insurance:
Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country
(permanent contracts only).
Transport
. Generous transit benefit
Learning & Training opportunities
. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.
Personal growth through coaching
: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential.
Learn more about our coaching culture
.
Parental leave
. Extended parental leave for all new parents,
for permanent contracts only.
Important note: we hire people not roles.
After reading this job description, if
you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites
but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position,
we encourage you to apply
!
Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

Cloudflare WARP, SaaS security controls

Role and permission automation for healthcare professionals, and their support and escalation process

About Nivoda 🚀
Nivoda is a rapidly scaling global B2B diamond and gemstone marketplace connecting jewellery retailers with competitive, high-quality suppliers worldwide. Processing $300M+ in annual transactions and operating across multiple regions, Nivoda is transforming a $350B industry that has historically been slow to modernise.
Our platform gives businesses of all sizes, from independent jewellers to major retail chains access to the world's best diamond and gemstone inventory, without the traditional barriers of capital, geography, or information asymmetry.
Our Mission 🎯
Diamond and gemstone trading has long been plagued by inefficiency, opacity, and exclusivity. Nivoda was built to change that - to democratise access and empower every business, regardless of size or location, to buy and sell with confidence. Independent jewellers are at the heart of this mission. They deserve the same access to quality, pricing, and selection as the biggest players in the industry. That's exactly what we give them.
The Team ⭐️
Our Sales team is the engine that brings Nivoda's mission to life. We're a high-energy, globally distributed group that moves fast, owns outcomes, and genuinely cares about the success of every jewellery business we work with. This is a team that thrives on commercial creativity, deep customer relationships, and relentless execution and we're growing fast.
About the Role 🤔
You are the front of the machine: you take inbound leads and hunt outbound prospects, qualify them fast, and get a demo on the AE's calendar. Your job ends when the demo is booked and confirmed — everything before that moment is yours.
This is a high-velocity, transactional sales role. Think SaaS SDR playbook: tight cadences, high activity volume, sharp qualification, relentless follow-up. You will run multichannel sequences (phone, email, WhatsApp, LinkedIn), work a CRM with discipline, and be measured weekly on activity and demos held.
What will you be doing? 😎
Work inbound leads within SLA (minutes, not hours) and convert them to booked demos.
Build and execute outbound sequences against target retailer lists; personalise at speed, not at leisure.
Qualify hard: right buyer type, purchase volume, intent, timeline. Kill bad leads quickly.
Book, confirm, and protect the demo — reduce no-shows with reminders and pre-demo touches.
Keep the CRM immaculate: every touch logged, every lead dispositioned, pipeline data trustworthy.
Feed learnings back: objections heard, messaging that lands, segments that convert.
What do we need from you? 💪
1–3 years in a SaaS or tech-sales SDR/BDR role with a transactional, high-volume motion — short cycles, big numbers, daily intensity.
A killer on the phone and crisp in writing; comfortable with 60–80+ meaningful touches a day.
Process-driven: you live in cadences and CRM hygiene rather than fighting them.
Coachable and resilient — you treat "no" as data and keep the energy up on day 20 of the month, not just day 1.
Native or professional proficiency in English and French is required for this role.
Jewellery knowledge not required; hunger and rigour are.
Our culture and what we offer 😉
At Nivoda, we believe that employees today want to evolve in a collaborative, high-growth environment where they can demonstrate their abilities and thrive both professionally and personally. We work to create a culture of empowerment, continuous learning, and growth where everyone can bring their expertise, own projects, and easily measure their impact. Dynamic working environment in a rapidly growing company. Enjoy a pleasant, low-hierarchy work environment. Engage in intellectually challenging work that contributes significantly to Nivoda's success and scalability.
Our current benefits
🕰️ Flexible working hours and a vibrant company culture
💻 Remote work
🧠 Plenty of opportunities for growth and learning
🏖️ Unlimited holiday allowance
🚀 Chance to join and contribute to a company during its exponential expansion phase
Equal Opportunity
Nivoda is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to promoting diversity. We don't discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Even if it seems you don't meet 100% of our musts - don't let it stop you. We are all about finding the best talent out there! Skills can be learned, and embracing diversity is invaluable.
Please note: Our Talent Acquisition Team is international. We kindly ask you to submit your CV and application in English so that it can be reviewed correctly.
Not quite the right fit?
If after reading this job description you believe this is not the best fit for you, we'd encourage you to join our
Nivoda Talent Pool
so we can keep you in mind as new roles open up.

postings.description:

About Nivoda 🚀
Nivoda is a rapidly scaling global B2B diamond and gemstone marketplace connecting jewellery retailers with competitive, high-quality suppliers worldwide. Processing $300M+ in annual transactions and operating across multiple regions, Nivoda is transforming a $350B industry that has historically been slow to modernise.
Our platform gives businesses of all sizes, from independent jewellers to major retail chains access to the world's best diamond and gemstone inventory, without the traditional barriers of capital, geography, or information asymmetry.

Our Mission 🎯
Diamond and gemstone trading has long been plagued by inefficiency, opacity, and exclusivity. Nivoda was built to change that - to democratise access and empower every business, regardless of size or location, to buy and sell with confidence. Independent jewellers are at the heart of this mission. They deserve the same access to quality, pricing, and selection as the biggest players in the industry. That's exactly what we give them.

About the Role 🤔
Conversion is one of the three chokepoints in our revenue organisation. Customers arrive, take the demo, go through KYC, and too many stall before the first purchase, or buy once and never come back. The second purchase is where the product becomes sticky, and getting a merchant there is the hardest 60 days of their life with us.
Fixing that takes two things, and this role owns both. Reps who know the product, the pricing and the playbook cold. And a conversion funnel that is measured, scored and coached rather than hoped for.

Function one: enablement
Training and standards
Make sure every rep is up to spec and trained, and keep them there.
Own the theoretical onboarding of every new rep, SDR, AE and AM alike: what Nivoda sells, to whom, at what price, and how.
Set what "up to spec" means for each role and hold the bar.
Documentation and materials
Own the product material for every line of business: how it works, who it is for, pricing, take rate and best practice.
Keep it current. A rep should never be the last person to find out something changed.
The channel to marketing
Act as the link between marketing and the front line. Every campaign is known to the reps in advance, socialised at the all-hands before it lands, not discovered from a customer.
The channel to product
Translate the product roadmap into enablement. You do not decide the roadmap. You turn it into what to sell, to whom, and when.
When something ships, the reps already know what it is and how to position it.
Function two: conversion
Conversion rests on two things, and this role owns both: the call, and the KYC. A brilliant call that dies in KYC converts nothing, and a clean KYC on a badly run call never gets there.
Call scoring
Build the scoring rubrics with the team managers, so the standard is one both sides recognise.
Run transcript review and scoring at volume, using Claude to do it.
Send the reports out every week, to everyone.
Run a weekly leaderboard: the best calls, the scores, winners and losers, visible to the team.
Build a personalised coaching plan for every rep, written down and tracked, not delivered verbally and forgotten.
Coach in two directions: with the managers so they can coach their own people, and directly with reps where that is faster.
KYC
Own the insight generation of what is working and not on the process
Hold the accountability of the KYC SLAs, and call it out when they slip.
Map the blockers and the escalation paths, and push the fix at the cause rather than the symptom, across sales, product and marketing as needed.
Make sure the KYC operators know the rules, and that the rules are written.
Train and enable both sides of it: the reps and the operations team.
How we will measure it
💻
Conversion through to second purchase at 75% of each new cohort.
KYC above 60%, in every geography, not just on the average.
Rubric and call scores in place and reported weekly.
80% compliance against the rubric, reached by your fourth month in the role.
What do we need from you? 💪
Experience in sales enablement, revenue operations or frontline sales coaching in a transactional, high-volume environment.
You have scored calls at volume and can show what changed as a result. Gong or equivalent.
You are fluent with AI tooling and would run transcript review and scoring through Claude rather than by hand.
You have built onboarding for reps from scratch, not just delivered someone else's deck.
You can coach a manager, not just a rep. You are comfortable telling a senior person their team's calls are not good enough, and then showing them how to fix it.
You write clearly. A large part of the value here is documentation other people can pick up and use.
You work across Product, Marketing and Finance without authority over any of them.
Hands-on. This is not a strategy seat. You will be on calls, in the CRM and in the material every week.
Nice to have ✨
Experience with onboarding or activation motions rather than pure new business.
Diamonds, jewellery, or another supply-driven marketplace.
A second language relevant to EMEA or North America.

postings.description:
Hybrid, based in our London, Bath or Edinburgh office. We are flexible but would like you to be in the office at least once per week.
About us
Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform, on a mission to help more people invest, and invest well.
We’re building the infrastructure behind the next generation of investing. Our technology already powers some of the UK’s most ambitious fintechs, banks, financial advisers and wealth firms, with close to a million investors relying on Seccl-powered platforms. And we’re now expanding into Europe.
We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale.
We’re proud to be part of Octopus, one of the UK’s most successful privately held investment and technology groups. That gives us the backing and long-term perspective to build something substantial, while keeping the pace and energy of a high-growth business. Seccl and Octopus are both B Corp certified and share a belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand.
If you want to help shape the future of investing in the UK and across Europe, you’ll be in good company.
Check out the Seccl
website
to see what we’re building and read more about our
mission
to shape the future of investments.
The role
We’re looking for an engineering manager to lead one of our product engineering squads, reporting to an engineering director. As Seccl grows and our platform supports more customer firms and investors, you’ll help your squad deliver the scalable platform capability we need for what comes next.
You’ll build a strong, psychologically safe engineering team where people feel trusted, supported and able to do their best work. You’ll coach and develop engineers, create clarity and help the team maintain high standards while delivering valuable outcomes.
Working closely with your product manager, engineering leaders and teams across Seccl, you’ll help define priorities and keep the squad focused on the right outcomes. You’ll balance delivery pace with engineering quality, security, operational resilience and long-term maintainability.
This role brings together people leadership, delivery and engineering accountability. You’ll stay close enough to the technology to guide and challenge decisions, while giving engineers the ownership and support they need to develop effective solutions.
What you’ll own
Building, leading and developing an inclusive, high-performing engineering squad
Creating an environment of trust, psychological safety, continual learning and constructive challenge
Owning the delivery health of your squad, from priorities and planning through to production readiness, reliability and ongoing maintainability
Partnering with product managers to align the squad’s work with customer, commercial, regulatory and platform priorities
Guiding technical decisions and helping the team build solutions that are scalable, secure, resilient and well integrated with the wider platform
Using metrics, feedback and team insight to improve delivery predictability, system reliability and team effectiveness
Recruiting and onboarding engineers while contributing to shared engineering practices and collaboration across Seccl
This role’s for you if...
You’re an experienced engineering manager who has led teams working within complex product or technology domains
You have a strong track record of hiring, onboarding, coaching and developing engineers
You can balance people leadership with delivery accountability and remain close enough to the technology to offer meaningful guidance
You have experience with a modern JavaScript and cloud-based technology stack. Our stack includes Node.js, JavaScript and TypeScript, MongoDB, AWS, Lambda and Serverless Framework
You communicate clearly and can work effectively with product managers, engineering leaders and senior stakeholders
You have recent, practical experience with AI-assisted engineering tools and can help teams use them responsibly to improve delivery, quality and developer effectiveness
You care about building secure, scalable and resilient systems. Experience in financial services, fintech, investment platforms or another regulated environment would be valuable
This role isn’t for you if...
You’re looking for a purely people-management role.
You’ll need enough technical credibility to guide decisions and challenge constructively
You want to be the primary technical decision-maker.
You’ll create the environment for engineers to own solutions and grow their capability
You need priorities to remain fixed.
You’ll be leading delivery in a fast-moving environment where plans and business needs can change
You prioritise speed at the expense of quality.
Delivery pace matters, alongside security, resilience and long-term maintainability

Private medical insurance with AXA Health
👪

MacBook and up to £500 towards your home office set-up

£750 annual learning budget

, including Octopus Money, the Octopus Share Incentive Plan and will writing through Octopus Legacy

Deine Mission bei ]init[
Als Senior Account Manager - Infrastruktur & Services (all genders) identifizierst und erschließt du Geschäftspotenziale bei Neu- und Bestandskunden im Großraum Hamburg. Du entwickelst Vertriebsstrategien, verantwortest Angebote und Vertragsverhandlungen und baust langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf. Mit deinem Marktverständnis platzierst du unser Portfolio gezielt und trägst aktiv zum Unternehmenserfolg bei.
Das gibt es zu tun
Du entwickelst und verantwortest den Vertrieb von Infrastruktur- und Service-Lösungen bei Neu- und Bestandskunden im Public Sector, speziell bei IT-Dienstleistern in Norddeutschland
Du identifizierst Geschäftspotenziale, baust belastbare Kundenbeziehungen auf und erreichst die vereinbarten Vertriebsziele
Du steuerst Ausschreibungen und Angebotsprozesse ganzheitlich, von der Bid-Strategie über die Kalkulation bis zur Präsentation beim Kunden
Du führst proaktive Vertriebs- und Kundenkampagnen durch und platzierst unser Portfolio gezielt bei relevanten Entscheidungsträgern

postings.description:
Über ]init[
Du möchtest die Gesellschaft von morgen mitgestalten? Dann bist du bei ]init[ richtig. Denn unsere digitalen Lösungen sind für Menschen gemacht und haben gesellschaftliche Relevanz. Klingt spannend? Dann steig ein und arbeite gemeinsam mit über 1.400 ]init[s in interdisziplinären Teams an unseren sieben Standorten – oder flexibel von überall in Deutschland aus.
Deine Mission bei ]init[
Gestalte die Digitalisierung des Public Sector von morgen!
Du willst nicht nur zuschauen, wie sich die deutsche Verwaltung modernisiert – sondern dein ganzes Know-how bei der Digitalisierung von Verwaltungsleistungen einsetzen? Sei es bei der Mitwirkung, bei der Umsetzung anspruchsvoller OZG-Verwaltungsleistungen nach dem Einer-für-Alle-Prinzip oder der Abschaffung aufwändiger Nachweispflichten für Bürger:innen und Unternehmen durch konsequente Umsetzung des Once Only-Prinzips durch die Registermodernisierung. Sei dabei als
Consultant Public Sector (all genders)
und das aus Hamburg heraus mit der Option auf Homeoffice!
Das gibt es zu tun
Du bist Teil der Consulting-Unit und verantwortlich für gestaltest (IT-)Beratungsprojekte mit
Du begleitest unsere Kunden aus dem Public Sector in Projekten zur Umsetzung von Digitalisierungsvorhaben
Du unterstützt in der Gestaltung von Strategien, Organisationen und Prozessen von Behörden der Bundes-, Landes- und Kommunalebene
Du erarbeitest gemeinsam im Projektteam die Anforderungen des Kunden und entwirfst innovative Lösungsstrategien und -konzepte
Du bildest dich kontinuierlich fort durch Fortbildungen und teaminternen Wissenstransfer
Das bringst du mit
Ein abgeschlossenes Studium, z. B. in Politikwissenschaft, Verwaltungswissenschaft, Verwaltungsinformatik, Rechtswissenschaft oder Wirtschaftsinformatik – oder einen anderen Hintergrund, der dich für das Tätigkeitsfeld qualifiziert. Auf bestimmte Studienrichtungen legen wir uns dabei bewusst nicht fest
Erste Praxis in der Beratung oder im IT-Projektmanagement – besonders freuen wir uns über Berührungspunkte mit der öffentlichen Verwaltung
Ein gutes Verständnis für Projektplanung und -steuerung; PMFlex kennst du idealerweise bereits oder möchtest dich schnell darin einarbeiten
Freude daran, die Einführung neuer IT-Lösungen von der Vorbereitung über Pilotierung und Tests bis zum erfolgreichen Go-live zu begleiten
Kommunikationsstärke und ein gutes Gespür dafür, unterschiedliche Nutzer und Stakeholder bei Veränderungen mitzunehmen – ob in Workshops, Informationsveranstaltungen, Sprechstunden oder Schulungen
Die Fähigkeit, komplexe Inhalte verständlich aufzubereiten und in Leitfäden, Handbüchern oder Unterlagen für die Gremienbeteiligung auf den Punkt zu bringen
Technisches Verständnis und Interesse an den Themen, die eine Systemeinführung mit sich bringt – von Konfiguration und Schnittstellen über Datenmigration und Customizing bis hin zu fachlichen und technischen Tests
Ein Blick dafür, was nach dem Go-live wichtig ist: Du denkst Support, Hypercare, Nutzerfeedback und den Übergang in stabile Betriebsstrukturen mit
Interesse an Verwaltungsdigitalisierung und daran, wie moderne IT-Services in öffentlichen Organisationen erfolgreich eingeführt und verankert werden
Kenntnisse rund um OZG, EfA, FIM, Datenschutz oder IT-Service Management sind ein Plus – wichtiger ist uns aber, dass du Lust hast, dich in diese Themen einzuarbeiten
Das bieten wir dir
Befristete Position auf 24 Monate: Du erhältst die Möglichkeit, wertvolle Erfahrungen in einem spannenden und dynamischen Umfeld zu sammeln
Because we care: Deine Work-Life-Balance liegt uns am Herzen. Aus diesem Grund sichern wir dir 30 Urlaubstage zu, flexible Arbeitszeiten sowie Workation im EU-Ausland!
Work with us: Wir arbeiten deutschlandweit mobil zusammen - full-time oder im Teilzeitmodell deiner Wahl. Du entscheidest, wo du arbeiten möchtest.

Eigne dir regelmäßig neue Kompetenzen an und wachse über dich hinaus, denn wir wollen, dass du gerne bei uns bist und dich nach deinen Interessen entwickeln kannst.
Grow with us: Lerne unsere Learning Lunches & Nutshells kennen, die dir neben deinem Einsatz in Projekten einen abteilungsübergreifenden Austausch ermöglichen. In unseren Teams unterstützen wir uns gegenseitig dabei, mutig zu denken, um gemeinsam den digitalen Wandel zu gestalten.

About WPP Media
